summary: This standards-track memo defines MIB objects for managing RADIUS authentication servers. It replaces RFC 2619 by deprecating the table limited to IPv4 addresses and adding a new one using version-neutral IP addresses, and adds UNITS and REFERENCE clauses to some objects.

eli5.summary: A RADIUS server decides who gets in. This gives network managers a dashboard to watch that decision-maker, now working with both old and new style addresses.
